name: pwru
description: eBPF-based kernel packet tracer by Cilium that shows the exact kernel path and drop location of network packets

install_steps: Or download the pwru binary for your platform from https://github.com/cilium/pwru/releases
Requires Linux kernel >= 5.4 with BTF and root privileges

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install pwru: go install github.com/cilium/pwru/cmd/pwru@latest (needs root to run)

commands.description: Trace packets through the kernel and show where they are dropped (sudo pwru --filter-dst-port 443). Ctrl-C to stop. Combine --filter-* flags to narrow traffic

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install pwru: go install github.com/cilium/pwru/cmd/pwru@latest (needs root to run)

commands.description: Show all pwru filter and output options (pwru --help) — protocol, ports, IPs, interfaces, output modes
Passthrough to pwru CLI (all --filter-* and --output-* flags)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install pwru: go install github.com/cilium/pwru/cmd/pwru@latest (needs root to run)
